title: DIY: Auto Skills Center Makes Fixing Your Own Vehicle a Breeze!

sections.markdown:
Auto repairs can be unexpected and become a financial burden, especially if you're not experienced working under the hood of a vehicle. People who lack automotive knowledge often spend more than they would like on repairs. While the idea of saving money by maintaining your own vehicle is appealing, you may not be up to the challenge.

That's where we come in.

sections.heading: The Do-It-Yourself Advantage
sections.markdown:
The Auto Skills Center provides a safe, professional environment for DIY automotive care. We offer everything you need to get the job done right, including:

* **Professional Facilities:** Ample workspace and approved HAZMAT storage.
* **Advanced Machinery:** Battery chargers, brake service equipment, steam cleaners, electronic testing devices
* **The Right Tools:** A full array of professional-grade tools at your fingertips.

Whether you are **changing your oil**, **rotating tires**, or **replacing brakes**, you'll have the space and equipment to do it efficiently.

sections.heading: Expert Guidance Every Step of the Way
sections.markdown:
Don't let lack of experience hold you back. Each center is staffed with ASE-certified mechanics available to offer guidance. We provide:

* Detailed repair manuals and computer printouts.
* Step-by-step assistance for nearly any task.
* A supportive environment to help you learn as you go.

sections.heading: Proven Savings for Your Family
sections.markdown: Auto Skills Center saves patrons millions of dollars collectively each year. On average, our visitors **save between $75 and $100 per visit** compared to commercial repair services. Performing your own repairs doesn't just save you money – with the right support, the process is rewarding and enjoyable.

sections.heading: Ready to get started?
sections.markdown: For more information and to find a facility near you visit [Auto Skills Center](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/services/automotive-services/auto-skills-development-center).
